articles.title: Kraken parent Payward says expansion outside crypto trading helps cushion revenue decline
articles.snippet: While earnings and the company’s newly introduced financial performance measure remained below year-earlier levels, there are signs of improvement from the second quarter.

articles.title: Bitcoin firm Nakamoto owes Kraken $165 million, more than its entire market value
articles.snippet: About 70% of the bitcoin treasury firm’s coins are pledged to the exchange, bought at roughly $118,000 each, and bitcoin now trades under $69,000.

articles.title: North Korea's Binance hack faces U.S. crackdown as DOJ targets $1.2 billion in stolen crypto
articles.snippet: Federal authorities say they've taken infrastructure used in the FaceStealer scheme used to steal as much as $400 million in crypto assets.

articles.title: The next Congress will write rules for AI and emerging tech. They should use the stuff first.
articles.snippet: The best thing industry leaders can do is to invest the time to ensure this country’s policymakers can experience the technology they’re regulating up close, writes Allie Page, executive director of American Innovation Project.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Huang quits company he co-founded, led for 3 decades. Shares slump
articles.snippet: CFO Colette Kress takes over as interim CEO after Huang steps down immediately as president, chief executive and board member, as shares tumble.
